req.title: Mark task complete
req.statement: The system shall set completed=true when a PUT payload includes {"completed": true}.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of marking a task as complete via the PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint. It includes a positive test to ensure the task is marked complete when the correct payload is provided, a negative test to handle invalid task IDs, and a boundary test to check the behavior when the task is already marked complete.

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_positive
preconditions: Task with id 4 exists and is not completed
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/4 with payload {'completed': true}
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put('/tasks/4', json={'completed': True})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_invalid_id
preconditions: Task with id 999 does not exist
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/999 with payload {'completed': true}
expected: Error message indicating task not found
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put('/tasks/999', json={'completed': True})
assert response.status_code == 404
assert 'Task with id 999 not found' in response.json()['detail']

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_already_completed
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists and is already completed
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/1 with payload {'completed': true}
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put('/tasks/1', json={'completed': True})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['completed'] is True
